MR_EGRESS
Description
This event is raised after the route has been selected and processed
and the message is delivered to the mr_proxy for forwarding on the new
connflow.
Examples
when MR_INGRESS {
  set client_addr “[IP::addr]:[IP::port]"
  MR::store client_addr
}
when MR_EGRESS {
  MR::restore client_addr
}
Related Information
The DIAMETER:: commands are available in MR_EGRESS starting with 13.0.0.
Before that, any DIAMETER:: values must be set in a variable in
DIAMETER_EGRESS. MR_EGRESS is raised after DIAMETER_EGRESS.
Available Commands:
DIAMETER::message
- returns the whole
Diameter message as a TCL string object.
MR::restore
- returns the stored variables
to the current context tcl variable store
